_doc: Băng Tâm Các lineage (rules-proposals R5). Outer gate: clear-frost-breath (Water; a Water root without Ice may practise it). Inner gate: winter-toll-canon (Ice; existing). Elders and true disciples: jade-vessel-ice-heart-canon (the founder's method). Head: stilled-hour-sutra (existing Heaven secret). Secret arts by rank: snow-plum-sword (inner), frost-lotus-array-canon (elders). Proposals are unpriced.

lineage.tree_route_note: Still Ice (Tĩnh Băng) and Frost Seed (Sương Chủng): the Jade Vessel's still heart and its first Ice stack, which every disciple of the canon opens before anything else.

techniques.name: Clear Frost Breathing Primer (Thanh Sương Thổ Nạp Quyết)
techniques.concept: The outer gate's method, taught on the frozen lake below the Pavilion. The disciple breathes glacier air into a Water dantian until breath and qi move at the same slow pace. It is gentle and slow, and it never harms a Water root. Its sixth layer is the Frost Test: the disciple sits on the lake ice for a night, and if Ice answers in their meridians the inner gate opens to them. Fewer than one in ten pass.

arts.concept: A slow palm that breathes out cold: a light Cold hit that slows the target's next art. The outer disciples' first art and their only one for years.

techniques.lore: Tần Ngưng Sương wrote it in 471, the year after the Pavilion took the ice of Ngọc Hồ Sơn, so that the desert-born could learn to breathe the cold before the cold learned them.

techniques.name: Jade Vessel Ice-Heart Canon (Ngọc Hồ Băng Tâm Kinh)
techniques.concept: The founder's own method and the sect's name. It cultivates a heart as clear and cold as a piece of ice in a jade vessel (the poet's line the sect is named for): the practitioner stills each feeling as it rises and lets it freeze clear rather than cloud the qi. Heart demons find nothing to hold. In a fight it is a ward method: frost wards that thicken while the holder stays still, and Ice stacks that ripen on any foe who strikes into them. The price is warmth. Those who reach the ninth layer seldom laugh, and their disciples feel it.

arts.new: Heart in the Jade Vessel (Tâm Tại Ngọc Hồ)
arts.concept: A held stance. It holds your damaging arts while your frost ward grows each second; each hit the ward absorbs lays an Ice stack on the attacker (two while the ward is above half its peak). When the ward reaches 25 % of your health or the foe carries ten Ice stacks, the stance ends and releases the ward as Cold damage on the foe, stronger for each Ice stack it consumes (all of them).
A frost lotus opens under a foe: each petal is an Ice stack, and the fifth freezes them for a breath.
Reflects the next soul or heart-demon art back on its caster as Cold damage.

techniques.lore: Tần Ngưng Sương carried the first copy across the desert in 440 inside the jade vessel itself, which is why the head of the sect is called the Keeper of the Vessel.

techniques.name: Snow Plum Sword Method (Tuyết Mai Kiếm Quyết)
techniques.concept: A sword of five cuts like the five petals of a plum blossom, each cut laying cold, the fifth falling like a blossom on snow. It came into the Pavilion from Lãnh Hương Các, the plum-blossom swordsmen who all died riding to break the siege of Cô Thành in 724 (V071). Their one surviving child brought it, and it is now the inner gate's sword.

arts.new: Five Petals of Cold (Ngũ Biện Hàn)
arts.concept: Five quick cuts, each laying one Ice stack; the fifth cut deals Cold damage scaled by the target's stacks.
A sword step that leaves an afterimage; a foe who strikes the afterimage takes two Ice stacks.

arts.new: Plum Falls on Snow (Mai Lạc Tuyết)
arts.concept: A single falling cut that freezes a foe with five or more Ice stacks for a breath and consumes them.

techniques.lore: The manual is copied in red ink, the way Lãnh Hương Các kept it. Phó Ám Hương will not let it be copied in black.

techniques.name: Frost Lotus Array Canon (Sương Liên Trận Kinh)
techniques.concept: The elders' array method. It teaches how to lay ice into earth, so that a formation holds its shape in a glacier the way stone holds it in a mountain. Its greatest work is the Jade Vessel Array under the Pavilion, which keeps the fire of Chúc Long Sơn sleeping beneath the ice. Fighting arrays come from it as well: frost-lotus seals that slow and freeze anyone who walks into them.

arts.concept: Lays a frost-lotus seal under the holder; foes inside take Ice stacks each second and their art speed falls.
Raises an ice wall ward that grows stronger the longer the holder stands inside the seal.

techniques.lore: Tiết Hàn Mai has kept the Jade Vessel Array for three hundred years and knows every node of it by touch. She has taught it whole to no one.
